headword: {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}
gloss: like new; as good as new

definitions.gloss: like new; as good as new; in mint condition
definitions.explanation: Describes a used item that is in excellent condition, virtually indistinguishable from a brand-new product.

examples.japanese: {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}の{状態|じょうたい}です。
フリマアプリで{新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}のバッグを{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a like-new bag on a flea market app.

examples.japanese: この{中古|ちゅうこ}パソコンは{新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}で、{傷|きず}も{汚|よご}れもまったくない。
examples.english: This used computer is like new, with no scratches or dirt at all.

notes:
A four-character compound combining {新品|しんぴん} (new item) and {同様|どうよう} (same as, equivalent to). Very commonly seen in online marketplaces, second-hand shops, and product listings to indicate excellent condition.

USAGE:
Used as a no-adjective: {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}の + noun. Also used as a standalone description in product listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}の{状態|じょうたい}: like-new condition
- {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}{品|ひん}: item in like-new condition
- {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}・{未使用|みしよう}: like-new/unused (listing categories)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未使用|みしよう}: unused — literally never been used
- {美品|びひん}: item in beautiful/excellent condition — slightly less than new
- {中古|ちゅうこ}: secondhand, used — general term without implying condition quality
